en: A black‑and‑white postcard showing a quiet residential street with several wooden houses featuring steep gabled roofs and decorative trim. Tall, thin pine trees stand near a path or road in the foreground, with more houses visible in the background. The layout suggests a small town or village scene. Printed text appears at the bottom of the image, including a caption and a small printer's or publisher's mark in an oval on the lower right.
